acceptedAnswer.text: The correct answer is B. The complex [Co(CN)6]3- is an example of a low-spin complex because the cyanide ligand is a strong field ligand that causes the electrons to pair up in the lower energy orbitals.

mainEntity.name: Which of the following complexes will exhibit geometrical isomerism?

acceptedAnswer.text: The correct answer is A. Geometrical isomerism occurs in complexes with a coordination number of 4 or 6. [Co(NH3)4Cl2] has a coordination number of 6 and can exhibit cis-trans isomerism.

mainEntity.name: The complex [Co(NH3)5NO2]Cl2 has how many geometrical isomers?
